Hotel Sales & Representation

Resort Sales Representation in India

Design a resort trade offer around travel access, length of stay, transfer details and seasonal capacity.

Discuss your project

Clarify what guests need to arrive

Give agents realistic transfer windows, baggage rules for small vehicles or boats, and late-arrival options. State what the price includes and how guests book activities.

Design for shoulder periods

Set offers around arrival days and lengths of stay that work commercially. Check whether transfer and dining capacity can support the bookings before opening allocations.
